title: Squirrel Simulation
goal: Minimize the squirrel travel needed to carry every nut individually to the tree.
strategy: Imagine every nut trip starting and ending at the tree. Only the first trip differs: it starts at the squirrel instead. Choose the nut with the greatest saved distance, even if every saving is negative.
